intent: Research, design and build an interactive map of public EV charging stations in Metro Manila with filters and a submit-a-station form.

spec.goal: Create an interactive map of public EV charging stations in Metro Manila that users can filter and add to by submitting new stations.
spec.deliverable: A working interactive web map of public EV charging stations in Metro Manila, with filters and a submit-a-station form, along with the researched station information it displays.
constraints: Covers public EV charging stations in Metro Manila only.
Station information must come from research into existing public charging stations.
Must include filters for browsing the stations.
Must include a form for users to submit a station.
done_criteria: The map shows researched public EV charging stations located in Metro Manila.
Users can pan or zoom the map and select a station to see its details.
Users can apply filters to narrow the stations shown on the map.
A submit-a-station form is present and lets a user enter details of a new station.
spec.summary: You want us to research public EV charging stations in Metro Manila, then design and build an interactive map of them with filters and a form for submitting new stations.
